last_review.summary: The change satisfies AUTH-001-B. It adds framework-neutral error-envelope and request-context interfaces with the required string fields, exports both through the src/common barrel, remains entirely within the allowed path, introduces no runtime behavior or architectural coupling, and passes the deterministic TypeScript build.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
